intro: Red Linen Goods is an Elwynn Forest task offered by seamstress Sara Timberlain at the Eastvale Logging Camp. In need of fabric, she asks passing adventurers to hunt down local Defias bandits and strip them of their linen bandanas. In exchange, she uses the reclaimed cloth to tailor useful goods for travelers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Defias gang in Northshire wears burlap masks, but the Defias in Elwynn wear linen which I can use to make fine linen goods.
Bring me red linen bandanas and I'll use them to fashion something for you.
Defias gang members have camps pocketed throughout Elwynn.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I'm running low on linen, friend. Do you have any for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, these are nice bandanas, if a little rough...
